what: On hover a 1px underline is drawn from the left in .6s ease, and on leave it clears toward the right end in .6s — the hover is held for 1s, so even if you leave mid-draw it finishes drawing before it clears (it never turns back halfway and always sweeps left to right). With keyboard focus it stays drawn

options.hold: Seconds to hold the enter — leave is accepted only after this long, default 1 (original data-enter-duration 1000)
options.out: Seconds it won’t be raised again while lifting, default 1
options.--fx-dur: Length of drawing and clearing the line (css), default .6s
options.--fx-offset: Distance lowered below the text (css), default -2px
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Underline — if none, the part makes one

from.where: shared.css .sf-hlink·.sf-plink·.sf-alink·.sf-ext (header line · menu drawer · footer links — original jsHover-underline .6s ease transform, enters from origin left, leaves from origin right, data-enter-duration 1000 · leave 1000 state machine)
